narr: A deep east-southeast monsoon flow brought plenty of Gulf of Mexico moisture into the region. A weak surface low extended through southwest New Mexico which helped to fuel slow moving thunderstorms with heavy rain and flash flooding.
ev: Flash flooding occurred through the mid to late evening hours. Multiple cars were stalled across Deming, underpasses were flooded and at least one house started taking in water.
lsr: TIME ESTIMATED. DURATION: THROUGHOUT THE EVENING. EMERGENCY MANAGER REPORTS MULTIPLE STALLED CARS ACROSS TOWN, FLOODED UNDERPASS, AND ONE HOUSE BEGAN TO FLOOD.
